root_cause: The Redis cache reached its 2 GB maxmemory limit and started evicting keys. Cache hit ratio collapsed, so every request fell back to the database, and evicted cart sessions made some checkouts fail with HTTP 500.
contributing_factors: Redis used_memory at its maxmemory limit
evidence: cache lookup failed, falling back to database

remediation.recommendation: Raise the Redis memory limit and stop session keys being evicted
steps: Raise Redis maxmemory or add a node
Use a separate eviction policy (volatile-lru) so session keys with no TTL are never evicted
Alert on cache hit ratio below 70%
